nodes.name: work_activity
nodes.definition: Observable category of work performed in the target role.

nodes.name: task
nodes.definition: A bounded unit of work with an intended result.

nodes.name: work_output
nodes.definition: A deliverable or state produced by work.

nodes.name: ksao
nodes.definition: Knowledge, skill, ability, or other attribute relevant to work.

nodes.name: work_context
nodes.definition: Environmental, organizational, social, or technological conditions of work.

nodes.name: requirement_importance
nodes.definition: Relative importance of a requirement to successful role performance.

nodes.name: minimum_constraint
nodes.definition: A hard eligibility or feasibility constraint.

nodes.name: seniority_level
nodes.definition: Expected complexity, autonomy, scope, and responsibility level.

nodes.name: experience_episode
nodes.definition: A bounded period of work, project, education, or other relevant activity.

nodes.name: candidate_task
nodes.definition: A task the candidate reports having performed.

nodes.name: contribution
nodes.definition: The candidate's specific contribution distinct from team output.

nodes.name: output
nodes.definition: A deliverable or observable result produced.

nodes.name: outcome
nodes.definition: A consequence associated with the contribution or output.

nodes.name: scope
nodes.definition: Scale, breadth, volume, complexity, or reach of the work.

nodes.name: tool_domain_exposure
nodes.definition: Experience with a tool, technology, method, or domain.

nodes.name: credential
nodes.definition: A degree, certification, license, award, or other formal signal.

nodes.name: fact
nodes.definition: A candidate-relevant statement treated as factual within the evidence record.

nodes.name: claim
nodes.definition: A proposition the CV may communicate about the candidate.

nodes.name: provenance
nodes.definition: The origin or support source for a fact or claim.

nodes.name: verifiability
nodes.definition: How readily a material fact or claim can be checked.

nodes.name: specificity
nodes.definition: Degree to which the evidence is concrete rather than vague.

nodes.name: uncertainty
nodes.definition: Material uncertainty attached to a fact, claim, or interpretation.

nodes.name: evidence_strength
nodes.definition: Support quality for the claim being made.

nodes.name: claim_calibration
nodes.definition: Degree to which wording strength matches available evidence.

nodes.name: signal
nodes.definition: Candidate information made salient to a receiver under uncertainty.

nodes.name: diagnosticity
nodes.definition: How much a signal helps distinguish relevant candidate states.

nodes.name: credibility
nodes.definition: How believable a signal appears to the receiver.

nodes.name: distinctiveness
nodes.definition: How much a signal differentiates the candidate from alternatives.

nodes.name: self_presentation
nodes.definition: Strategic presentation of truthful candidate information.

nodes.name: inflation_risk
nodes.definition: Risk that presentation exceeds or distorts underlying evidence.

nodes.name: requirement_match
nodes.definition: Match between a target requirement and candidate evidence.

nodes.name: transferability
nodes.definition: Plausibility that evidence from one context applies to the target context.

nodes.name: semantic_alignment
nodes.definition: Alignment between candidate evidence and target-role terminology/meaning.

nodes.name: perceived_pj_fit
nodes.definition: Human perception that candidate characteristics fit job demands.

nodes.name: perceived_po_fit
nodes.definition: Human perception of candidate–organization fit.

nodes.name: relevance_weight
nodes.definition: Priority assigned to evidence for the current target role.

nodes.name: section_architecture
nodes.definition: Selection and arrangement of major CV sections.

nodes.name: information_hierarchy
nodes.definition: Ordering and emphasis that determine what is noticed first.

nodes.name: bullet_structure
nodes.definition: Micro-structure used to encode experience/evidence statements.

nodes.name: clarity
nodes.definition: Ease with which intended meaning can be understood.

nodes.name: information_density
nodes.definition: Amount of useful information per unit of document space.

nodes.name: terminology
nodes.definition: Role-relevant lexical choices used to express evidence.

nodes.name: tailoring
nodes.definition: Truthful adaptation of evidence selection and wording to a target role.

nodes.name: visual_hierarchy
nodes.definition: Typography, spacing, alignment, and grouping that guide reading.

nodes.name: export_integrity
nodes.definition: Preservation of readable and parseable structure in the final file.

nodes.name: attention
nodes.definition: Allocation of reviewer visual/cognitive attention.

nodes.name: inference
nodes.definition: Reviewer interpretation from observed CV information.

nodes.name: perceived_credibility
nodes.definition: Reviewer judgment that information is believable.

nodes.name: perceived_competence
nodes.definition: Reviewer judgment of candidate capability.

nodes.name: cognitive_load
nodes.definition: Mental effort required to process the document.

nodes.name: heuristic_judgment
nodes.definition: Use of simplified cues or rules in screening.

nodes.name: stereotype_bias
nodes.definition: Influence of demographic/social stereotypes on judgment.

nodes.name: shortlist_decision
nodes.definition: Human decision to advance or reject at a screening stage.

nodes.name: parsing
nodes.definition: Extraction of text/structure from the document.

nodes.name: section_detection
nodes.definition: Identification of CV sections and their boundaries.

nodes.name: entity_extraction
nodes.definition: Extraction of entities such as employers, roles, dates, education, and skills.

nodes.name: normalization
nodes.definition: Mapping variant terms to normalized entities or taxonomies.

nodes.name: lexical_retrieval
nodes.definition: Retrieval or matching based mainly on tokens/terms.

nodes.name: semantic_retrieval
nodes.definition: Retrieval or matching based on learned semantic representations.

nodes.name: ranking
nodes.definition: Ordering candidates/documents according to a scoring or recommendation function.

nodes.name: knockout_rule
nodes.definition: Deterministic rule that blocks or passes an application.

nodes.name: llm_evaluation
nodes.definition: LLM-mediated summarization, comparison, or judgment of applications.

nodes.name: algorithmic_bias
nodes.definition: Systematic differential effects arising from data/model/process design.

nodes.name: parse_success
nodes.definition: Whether required document information is successfully extracted.

nodes.name: recruiter_review
nodes.definition: Whether the application receives meaningful human review.

nodes.name: interview_invitation
nodes.definition: Whether the candidate is invited to interview.

nodes.name: offer
nodes.definition: Whether the candidate receives an employment offer.

nodes.name: job_performance
nodes.definition: Posthire performance criterion.

nodes.name: turnover
nodes.definition: Posthire retention/separation criterion.

nodes.name: validity
nodes.definition: Degree to which an inference or method supports its intended interpretation/use.

nodes.name: reliability
nodes.definition: Consistency of measurement or judgment.

nodes.name: fairness
nodes.definition: Normative/measurement property concerning equitable treatment and outcomes.

nodes.name: discrimination_risk
nodes.definition: Risk of differential treatment based on irrelevant or protected characteristics.

nodes.name: privacy
nodes.definition: Control and appropriateness of candidate information exposure.

nodes.name: source_freshness
nodes.definition: Recency and continued applicability of an external source.

nodes.name: context_boundary
nodes.definition: Conditions under which a finding or rule is expected to hold.

nodes.name: causal_identification
nodes.definition: Strength of evidence for a causal rather than associational claim.
